summary_text: Q1 2026 results (reported 2026-05-07): Revenue $2.31B (3.2% beat), non-GAAP EPS $1.22 (10.3% beat). Revenue growth +19% YoY. Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 320bps YoY to 32.0%. Driven by commercial+defense aerospace demand and gas turbine market growth. Engine products were leading contributor. Raised FY revenue guide to $9.65B midpoint (from $9.1B, +6%); raised FY Adj EPS guide to $4.94 midpoint (+11%). F-35 program tailwind and engine spares demand. CEO warned of Iran conflict risk to demand.
